### David Flees Jerusalem
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/david-flees-jerusalem
Passage: 2 Samuel 15:25-26
Points:
- The crisis of Absalom's rebellion jolts David out of spiritual neglect back to faithful leadership.
- Ittai the Gittite models steadfast loyalty by refusing to desert David in his exile.
- David returns the ark of God to Jerusalem, demonstrating humble submission to the Lord's sovereign will.
- Genuine trust in God's providence leads to active, wise obedience rather than passive resignation.

### Day 65: 2 Samuel 15:13–31
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-65-2-samuel-15-1331.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 15:14
Points:
- Faced with Absalom's uprising, David flees Jerusalem in deep grief, feeling trapped in self-appointed failure.
- Mourning and overwhelmed, David and his followers ascend the Mount of Olives.
- In his darkest moment on the mountain, David turns his despair into prayer, recorded in Psalm 3.
- Turning to God restores David's inner strength, allowing him to walk forward in faith rather than fear.
